_comment: NewsArticle schema for real-time news content. Submit these via a news sitemap with a 48h rolling window.

example.headline: Anthropic Raises $2B Series E at $60B Valuation
example.description: Anthropic closes its largest funding round to date, valuing the Claude maker at $60 billion — a 3x increase from its previous round.

newsSitemapExample:
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<urlset xmlns="http://www.sitemaps.org/schemas/sitemap/0.9"
        xmlns:news="http://www.google.com/schemas/sitemap-news/0.9">
  <url>
    <loc>https://example.com/news/anthropic-series-e-60b</loc>
    <news:news>
      <news:publication>
        <news:name>Your Site Name</news:name>
        <news:language>en</news:language>
      </news:publication>
      <news:publication_date>2026-08-15T09:30:00-04:00</news:publication_date>
      <news:title>Anthropic Raises $2B Series E at $60B Valuation</news:title>
      <news:keywords>anthropic, funding, AI</news:keywords>
    </news:news>
  </url>
</urlset>
notes: News sitemaps should only contain articles from the last 48 hours
Submit news sitemap separately from your main sitemap in GSC
Use ISO 8601 timestamps with timezone — Google needs the exact publication time
Ping Google's WebSub hub after every publish: POST to https://pubsubhubbub.appspot.com
The seoTitle (used in <title> tag) should be query-shaped; the headline can be punchy
